description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the meal planning screen in a calorie tracker app. It manages state, renders UI for displaying and adding meal items, handles date selection, and interacts with providers and services for data management.

classes.name: MealPlanScreen
classes.description: Main widget class representing the meal plan screen.

classes.name: _MealPlanScreenState
classes.description: State class managing internal state and UI logic for MealPlanScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers data refresh on widget creation.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Refreshes day's meal data from the provider.

methods.name: _pickDate
methods.description: Opens a date picker to select a date and refreshes data accordingly.

methods.name: _addItemDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet to add a new food item to a meal.

methods.name: _section
methods.description: Builds UI section for a specific meal type.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire UI for the meal plan screen.
